summary: HORIZON Stage 1 Home redesign tested at 1920x1080, 1366x768, 3840x2160 and with reduced motion. Backend pytest: 161 passed, 16 skipped. Most requested flows work. The Stage loads 'Sample Movie' with eyebrow 'Continue watching', chips Movie|2024|1 min left, the NFO plot, the amber progress bar and focus on 'Resume from 0:44'. Details opens /movies/2. Enter on Resume opens /play/2?start=44 and the video reaches readyState 4 at about 47 s. ArrowDown/ArrowUp moves between the stage, the tabs and the cards. Focusing a tab switches the group. Left/Right stops at both edges of the strip and the focus ring is visible. Hover and focus update the Stage. Series items show 'Explore series' with no Details button and open /shows/<id>. A movie with no progress shows Play and opens /play/1?start=0. Tab counts are 1/3/2. The grid toggle persists after reload. Fallback art is correct: Big Test Pattern and Sample Show show real posters, and the other titles show art-fallback cards with their title. Focus is restored after Escape or browser back. The footer string is correct and the /api/home sources field contains no paths. First run works: remove folder, first-run screen, 'Add media folder' to /settings, re-add by typed path, 3 movies again, and Sample Movie is still in Continue watching. Reduced motion sets transform to none. Movies, TV, Show detail and player controls work. Two keyboard/navigation bugs and some visual issues were found.

ui_bugs.issue: When a film card or a stage button has focus, PageDown/PageUp (LB/RB) switches the group but focus drops to <body>. The old group's cards unmount. The stage-copy div uses key={`copy-${item.key}`}, so the Resume/Play button remounts whenever the stage item changes. The next Arrow key then jumps to the stage primary button through focusFirst(main), so a controller user loses their place. Fix: after onGroup from PageUp/PageDown, focus the first card of the new group if focus was inside the strip. Also avoid keying the actions container on item.key, or refocus the primary action if it had focus.

ui_bugs.component: Player exit / history (Phase 0 behaviour, now visible from Home)
ui_bugs.issue: Resume from Home, then Escape in the player, lands on /movies/2 instead of Home, because Player.tsx:69 navigates to context.back with replace:false. Pressing Escape again on details calls navigate(-1), which goes back to /play/2?start=47 and restarts playback. Back loops between details and player. Fix: exit the player with navigate(-1) when there is history, or use replace:true, so Home and its focus restoration come back.

In grid view the aurora focus ring on the card is clipped on the top, left and right. Only a thin strip at the bottom is visible. Cause: .filmstrip--grid .film-slot { content-visibility: auto } adds paint containment, which clips the box-shadow ring that extends outside the slot. Fix: remove content-visibility, or add padding or overflow room to the slot.

MovieDetail.tsx:30 still uses the old
title
, which has no styles now. Titles without a poster show raw text in the top-left corner of an empty box. Use the TitleArt procedural card, as Home and Movies do. ShowDetail is fine for Sample Show but should be checked for Other Series.

issues: The library-status footer sits at y=751-820, below a 768 px viewport. The page scrolls and the status is cut off at first glance. Tighten the stage or strip height in the max-height:799px media query.

Nothing is clipped, but the UI is tiny for a 4K 10-foot view: title about 80 px, poster at most 200 px, stage about 560 px tall. Roughly 55% of the screen below the strip is empty. Consider viewport-scaled tokens above 2560 px.
detail-body uses padding 56px, while the nav and Home use --safe-x (about 78 px at 1920). The poster starts to the left of the HORIZON wordmark. Use var(--safe-x).
Procedural fallback cards print the title inside the art, and the label below repeats it (for example 'Sample Movie' twice). This is a little redundant.
The selected card's label is pushed 14 px lower than its neighbours, so the label gap looks uneven. This is a minor polish point.
Play on Legacy Clip (AVI) goes straight to the 'can't be played here' panel. The Stage could show a compatibility hint first.
The heading wraps to 3 lines in a narrow column at 1920 while the right half is empty. This is acceptable but could be wider.

action_items: Keep focus inside the strip on PageUp/PageDown: focus the first card of the new group. Stop remounting the stage action buttons (the stage-copy key) while they have focus.
Fix player exit history: return with navigate(-1) or use replace, so Escape from the player resumed on Home goes back to Home and Escape on details never reopens the player
Fix the grid-view focus ring clipped by content-visibility:auto on .film-slot
Use TitleArt for the MovieDetail (and ShowDetail) poster fallback instead of the unstyled .art-fallback div
Fit the 1366x768 home, including the library-status footer, in the viewport. Consider 4K scaling. Align detail page padding with --safe-x.
critical_code_review_comments: StageHero: key={`copy-${item.key}`} on .stage-copy remounts the focused primary button on every stage change. This is the root cause of focus loss with PageUp/PageDown when the button has focus.
LivingFilmstrip: the PageUp/PageDown handler calls onGroup but never moves focus. Unmounted focused cards leave document.activeElement as body.

Home: restoreKey stays as the restored key for the whole session. data-autofocus can therefore point to a stale card after the group changes. This is harmless, but it should be cleared after the first use.
Player.tsx: navigate(info.context.back, {replace:false}) pushes a new entry and creates a back loop with the App fallback navigate(-1).
spatial.ts data-nav-row edge stop works correctly: in strip mode, Left/Right never leave the strip, and the nav-edge nudge plays.
seed_data_creation: None. Library /app/sample_media was removed and re-added through the UI and is now library id 1 again with 3 movies, 2 shows and 3 episodes. Sample Movie progress was set back to 44 s. LAN was not touched and stays OFF.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Movie ids: 1=Legacy Clip (AVI, unsupported panel), 2=Sample Movie (progress 44s), 3=Big Test Pattern (real poster). Shows: 1=Other Series (fallback), 2=Sample Show (poster). Card testids: film-card-cw-2, film-card-movie-{1,2,3}, film-card-show-{1,2}. To retest, clear sessionStorage 'horizon.home.focus' and localStorage 'horizon.home.view' first. Retest these: PageDown with a card focused (check that activeElement is not BODY); Resume, then Escape in the player, then Escape again (must not reopen /play); the grid ring screenshot.
